sentences.text: Sharon Christa McAuliffe -LRB- September 2 , 1948 -- January 28 , 1986 -RRB- was an American teacher from Concord , New Hampshire , and was one of the seven crew members killed in the Space Shuttle Challenger disaster .	New Hampshire	New Hampshire

She received her bachelor 's degree in education and history from Framingham State College in 1970 , and also a master 's in education supervision and administration from Bowie State University in 1978 .	Framingham State College	Framingham State University	Bowie State University	Bowie State University
She took a teaching position as a social studies teacher at Concord High School in New Hampshire in 1983 .	Concord High School	Concord High School (New Hampshire)	New Hampshire	New Hampshire

In 1985 , she was selected from more than 11,000 applicants to participate in the NASA Teacher in Space Project and was scheduled to become the first teacher in space .	NASA	NASA	Teacher in Space Project	Teacher in Space Project
As a member of mission STS-51-L , she was planning to conduct experiments and teach two lessons from Space Shuttle Challenger .	STS-51-L	STS-51-L
On January 28 , 1986 , the shuttle broke apart 73 seconds after launch .

After her death , schools and scholarships were named in her honor , and in 2004 she was posthumously awarded the Congressional Space Medal of Honor .	Congressional Space Medal of Honor	Congressional Space Medal of Honor
